tweetText: Retailers are upgrading their AI systems to enhance customer personalization and insights in real-time. This shift is crucial for meeting today's conversion goals and improving customer experiences. via AI News

Japan's government has unveiled a plan to deploy 10 million AI robots across 18 industries by 2040, supported by $6.1 billion in funding. This move aims to address the country's significant worker shortage. via AI News

The Bank of England is assessing if current regulations can effectively manage agentic AI in finance. This matters because new AI capabilities could impact payments, trading, and security, requiring updated rules. via AI News.

Anthropic has launched Claude Sonnet 5 and restored its Fable and Mythos models after an 18-day pause due to a federal export control review. This is significant as it allows the company to resume using its top AI systems. via AI News

Congrats to the BAIR Lab class of 2026 for their incredible achievements in AI and machine learning! Their groundbreaking work will shape the future of technology across various fields. via BAIR Berkeley.

Tech tycoon Bhavin Turakhia is investing $30M of his own money to build an AI-powered alternative to Microsoft Office. This move signals a massive bet on AI tools replacing traditional productivity software. via TechCrunch AI
SpaceX showed investors a prototype for a new AI-powered handheld device. This suggests the company wants to expand into the wireless market. via TechCrunch AI

Ashton Kutcher is launching a new venture capital firm with Morgan Beller. This shift moves focus from AI software to the essential infrastructure and energy needed to power it. via TechCrunch AI

Cloudflare is requiring AI companies to pay for publishers' content by separating their web crawlers by September 15 or face being blocked. This move could significantly impact how AI firms access online information. via TechCrunch AI
Venice AI has raised $65M in Series A funding, achieving unicorn status with over $70M in annual revenues. This shows strong demand for privacy-first AI solutions in today's market. via TechCrunch AI
